issues.problem: cv-kiru mistake: チケットはもう売り終わりました is grammatical ('we have finished selling the tickets'), so the 'bad' sentence was not clearly wrong.
issues.action: Replaced with 数え終わらないほど星があった → 数え切れないほど, which is clearly wrong for 'countless'.

issues.problem: cv-kiru contrast said 'Sold out' is always 売り切れる; transitive 売り切る (the seller sold out) also exists.
issues.action: Reworded to 'Goods selling out is 売り切れる.'

issues.problem: cv-au explain gave 付き合う only as dating / keeping company, missing the common 'associate, have dealings with' sense (仕事の付き合い), which made the mistake note inaccurate.
issues.action: Added the dealings sense to explain and to the mistake note.

issues.problem: cv-naosu example English 'I'll think again a little more about studying abroad' was awkward.
issues.action: Changed to 'I'll reconsider studying abroad a little more.'

issues.problem: cv-kakeru mistake 赤ちゃんが急に泣きかけた is readable as 'suddenly almost cried', so not plainly wrong.
issues.action: Added 、一時間も泣き続けた to both bad and good so かける (stopping short) clearly contradicts the sentence.

issues.problem: Intro said 'fix the second verb to the stem', which clashes with 直す 'fix' taught in the same guide.
